name: Pad kra pao squid
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai (pork, 2 plates: 3 garlic cloves, 3 chillies, 1 cup holy basil, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tsp soy sauce) and Eating Thai Food (chicken, 2 plates: 5 garlic cloves, 4 to 10 chillies, 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp oyster sauce, 1 handful of holy basil) agree on the sauce. Long beans are Rachel's optional green beans. Oil is 1 tablespoon (15 g) a plate, the low end of the 1 to 2 tablespoons a street cook uses, since the pages leave it loose (Eating Thai Food: 1 tablespoon for 2 plates; Rachel Cooks Thai names none). Protein is the cooked weight of one plate, 75 to 100 g; frying and basil wilting take about 10 percent of the weight. Squid is raw weight.
